description: Upadek, the spirit of falling, a pale grey ghostly figure plunging head first diagonally, its tattered cloak streaming upward behind it like broken wings, long thin arms reaching down with clawed fingers, a hollow face with glowing eyes, falling bark chips around it, an abstract eerie creature, a bold simple silhouette filling the whole picture, few big readable shapes, strong light and dark contrast, a crisp dark outline, little fine detail, menacing, full body, the figure alone, no ground, no background, the whole figure inside the picture
